## About

Principal Engineer with experience designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems across multiple projects. I drive technical strategy, system design, implementation, and cross-team delivery while mentoring engineers and shaping technical direction. I focus on resilient event-driven architectures, real-time data processing, and pragmatic system design using Scala, Java, Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, and cloud-native patterns. I'm also exploring Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, and LLM integration to bring practical AI features into production services.

Currently exploring: Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, LLM integration, AI/ML technologies, and containerization with Docker/Kubernetes

## Projects

- [Git Commit MCP Server](https://surajfale.netlify.app/apps/git-commit-mcp-server): A lightweight MCP server that automates Conventional Commit message generation, changelog updates, and optional git pushes. Ideal for AI-assisted, well-formed commit messages and automated changelog management. Python 3.10+, MCP Protocol, Git. Source: https://github.com/surajfale/git-mcp-server
- [Notes & Tasks Web Application](https://surajfale.netlify.app/apps/notes-tasks-app): A modern, production-ready web app for managing notes and tasks with full offline support, list organization, and a responsive Material Design 3 UI. Features rich text notes, task tracking, JWT authentication, and seamless sync. SvelteKit, Node.js, Express, MongoDB Atlas, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS. Source: https://github.com/surajfale/notes-tasks
- [Rusty Clipboard](https://surajfale.netlify.app/apps/rusty-clipboard): A fast, terminal-based clipboard manager for Windows 11 built in Rust. Instantly access and search clipboard history with Vim-style navigation, all from a convenient right-side sidebar inside your terminal. Rust, SQLite, ratatui, Windows 11. Source: https://github.com/surajfale/rusty-clipboard
- [Voice Enabled Grocery App](https://surajfale.netlify.app/apps/voice-grocery-list): A smart grocery list application with voice recognition capabilities, making shopping lists more accessible and efficient. React, Voice API, JavaScript, Netlify. Source: https://github.com/surajfale/voice-grocery-list_app
- [Developer Tools Collection](https://surajfale.netlify.app/apps/developer-tools-collection): A curated collection of essential developer tools and utilities to boost productivity and streamline development workflows. React, TypeScript, Material-UI, Netlify. Source: https://github.com/surajfale/dev-tools
